# Lead Lab Application
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

Canonical project container for the Lead Lab application source, environment evidence, tests, operations records, and ICM run artifacts.

## Folder Map

```text
application/
├── CONTEXT.md
├── environment/  server and deployment evidence, no secrets
├── ops/          operating procedures and non-secret release notes
├── runs/         cycle-specific ICM artifacts
├── source/       canonical application code
└── tests/        automated tests and synthetic fixtures
```

## Routing

| Need | Location |
|---|---|
| Run the delivery workflow | `workspaces/lead-lab-workspace/CONTEXT.md` |
| Inspect or change application code | `source/` |
| Record server capabilities | `environment/` |
| Add tests or synthetic fixtures | `tests/` |
| Record operating or release evidence | `ops/` |
| Read or write a cycle run | `runs/<run-slug>/` |

## Current State

- The local application source uses Laravel, Inertia React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui, with the first protected session vertical slice implemented.
- Local development uses SQLite; staging and production still require MySQL or MariaDB verification.
- The local build and Measure audit pass conditionally; participant creation or invitation, browser playback evidence, and staging operations remain open.
- The approved product baseline is the Option B self-hosted web application.
- The previous WordPress build remains historical evidence and is not the current application source.
- SharePoint remains the launch fallback until acceptance.

## Rules

- Keep source code in `source/` and history in Git.
- Keep generated cycle artifacts in a confirmed run folder under `runs/`.
- Do not store credentials, private keys, tokens, or real participant data here.
- Do not deploy to production from this container without the required review and release authority.
